meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: The commercial bank survey: banks' deposits from residents, call borrowings and their claims on government and the commercial sector, every fortnight (also reports 100 and 903)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 443 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. 52 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2024-01-26, 2024-02-09, 2023-08-25, 2024-03-22 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Loans and Advances from the RBI on 2003-08-08).
